description: In the Virtualmin control panel (accessible at https://localhost:10000, login: root / GymAnything123!), create a new virtual server for the domain 'newclient.test'. The virtual server should have the following features enabled: web hosting (Apache), email (Postfix/Dovecot), DNS (BIND), and MySQL database. Set the administration password for the virtual server to 'NewClient456!'. Leave all other settings at their defaults. After clicking 'Create Server', wait for Virtualmin to finish setting up the domain.
